commits_data.title: UET: Fix TSS header fields [issue/21400]
commits_data.message:
UET: Fix TSS header fields [issue/21400]

- removed fields `nh` and `ver` as they do not appear in the UETH
specification.
- fixed TSS field bitmastks and positions to match the specification.
- updated header length from 20B to min 12B to reflect variable header
  length depending on `sp` flag
- decode `ssi` field conditionally based on `sp` flag.

Assisted-by: Claude
